Chapter 1: Troll's Spire

On a mountaintop in the Misty Vale stands Troll's Spire, a star-gazing tower of Eledain's sorcerers wrapped in ever-blooming red and black roses whose scent dazes the unwary. The tiny old troll-witch Harga has made its laboratory her home, guarded by her horned toad Ambrosius and a scattering of nasty pranks, while the harpy sisters Thistle, Prickle and Thorn roost on the roof and have stolen the key to the crypt below. Harga offers to lead the heroes to the vault's treasures if they clear out the harpies — knowing full well the crypt is a trap of pressure plates, skeletal guardians and a door that only seals behind them. Survival depends on remembering an old rhyme: over moon, under ground, fall the stars.
